# BeatGig — account brief

## Who
BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org lists beatgig.com as its website ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is in the beatgig/beatgig-mobile repo ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).
- beatgig-mobile last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)).
- The App Store listing has 1,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).
- 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), top contributor to beatgig/beatgig-mobile with 88 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). No title or bio is listed.
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), contributor to beatgig/beatgig-mobile with 19 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). No title or bio is listed.

## Why now
beatgig-mobile last pushed on 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)), and the app shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). The repo is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 88 commits in beatgig-mobile, which builds through EAS on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). The App Store listing shows 2 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you need to fix something between those two releases, does it go out over the air or wait for review?
